project_type: Tauri 2 / Rust native desktop + vanilla JavaScript frontend (Vite)
build_system: Vite 6.2.0 + npm scripts; Tauri 2 CLI for desktop; Vitest 3.0.7 for testing
test_framework: vitest (unit tests), happy-dom + jsdom for DOM testing
verification_instructions: After each fix: run `npm run test` and verify all tests pass. For visual issues (PDF, accent colors), manual inspection required. For security issues, verify no console errors or warnings. Check `npm run lint` for code quality.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ and dist-release/ are git-ignored. qa-report.json is generated by `npm run qa:ci` and git-tracked for CI gating. Build artifacts not checked in.
environment_constraints: Tauri app uses restricted Tauri 2 permissions; path traversal guards in Rust backend. Virtual storage fallback for test/browser environments. DOMPurify is required for sanitization.
contribution_requirements: See README.md and ARCHITECTURE.md. All changes must pass vitest suite and lint. Security changes require manual code review before merge. PDF/UI changes benefit from screenshot comparison.
key_patterns: Services layer in src/services/ provide abstractions. Components in src/components/ use modern ES6 modules. Styles use CSS variables (tokens.css) for theming. All HTML generation sanitizes with DOMPurify. Promises are explicit; async/await preferred. Git commits are atomic and signed when required.
relevant_files: src/services/export-engine.js (PDF generation, Puppeteer options, image handling)
directory_structure: src/ contains app/, components/, core/, services/, styles/, main.js. src-tauri/ contains Rust backend. tests/ contains unit/, integration/, security/, reliability/ subdirs. .agents/tasks/ is artifact root (outside worktree). Public/ contains static assets. docs/ contains architecture and release guides.
